tools.grit: grit 0.5.22 with lean CLI tree metadata diff

methodology: Exact issue #2083 fixture: 120000 files in 400 directories, 20 lines each, 20000 files appended with edited\n. One warmup per tool, then five interleaved runs reversing order each round, builds and tests idle. Python perf_counter around /usr/bin/time -v; median wall time and maximum peak RSS. API consumer prints each returned DiffEntry. Release rows use cargo build --release; -dist rows use the shipped dist profile (fat LTO, one codegen unit). Packed copy uses git repack -ad and git prune-packed.
verification: Every name-status run returns the same 20000 modified rows as system Git; --name-only and --json runs return 20000 paths; both 140804-object fixtures pass git fsck --strict.
